Congress leader's 'Gungi Gudiya' remark against Sunetra Pawar sparks row

A Congress leader's use of the term 'Gungi Gudiya' (mute doll) to refer to Sunetra Pawar has triggered a political controversy. The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) announced a protest in Vashi over the alleged remarks. Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis criticized the Congress for the comment, calling it a low-level tactic for publicity. The Congress leader reportedly expressed regret for the remark after the ensuing row.
